_comment: W1-T14149: initial debt measured on merge-base b17638178da45ac1754cb0883a35089579e765ba (2399 emitted, 972 read outside their writers, 1427 write-only). "writeOnly" is pre-existing debt and only shrinks. Remove an entry when it gains a reader or stops being emitted. A new write-only step needs an external reader or a "recordOnly" entry with a non-empty reason.

recordOnly.worker.flight_signal.tripped: W1-T4049: an observe-only mid-run trip of the repetition or error-loop predicate, once per run per predicate; nothing halts or decides on it until its trip precision is measured.
recordOnly.worker.flight_signal.error: W1-T4049: a diagnostic that a live flight-signal predicate threw; the stream loop carries on, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.review.withheld_exhausted: W1-T13945: the hold record for an input whose every eligible evaluator withheld its verdict, naming each attempt for the operator; only its writer reads it, to escalate once per head and input.
recordOnly.queue_judge.escalation_closed: W1-T14651: an audit row for the operator that the judge closed one of its own floor escalations the corrected rule admits; the closed issue carries the state, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.queue_judge.escalation_close_failed: W1-T14651: a diagnostic for a failed close of a floor escalation; it records the error and the next pass retries the close, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.dispatch.expedited: W1-T14654: an audit row for the operator, one per expedited start with its reason and lane share; nothing decides on it
recordOnly.review.proof_execution: W1-T14036: phase-time measurement rows read by operator analysis, not by code
recordOnly.review.proof_phase: W1-T14036: phase-time measurement rows read by operator analysis, not by code
recordOnly.dispatch.no_start.detected: W1-T14608: the daemon's own row for a no-start page; the operator reads it, and the catalogue's escalated row carries the dedup
recordOnly.dispatch.no_start.unassessed: W1-T14608: a diagnostic for a no-start judgement that could not be made; it records the error and pages nothing
recordOnly.target_job.stalled: W1-T14600: the operator page for a target job the core daemon deferred past its bound; the catalogue's own dedup reads the escalated row
recordOnly.target_job.stall_escalated: W1-T14600: the operator page for a target job the core daemon deferred past its bound; the catalogue's own dedup reads the escalated row
recordOnly.ci-friction.pass: An audit row for the operator (W1-T13989): it counts the units a ci-friction pass resumed from its journal and the units it ran fresh; nothing decides on it.
recordOnly.ci-friction.stage: W1-T14677: one timing row per ci-friction inventory stage, for the operator to see where a long pass spent its time; nothing decides on it
recordOnly.garden.unit_journal_failed: A diagnostic (W1-T13989): a garden's unit journal could not be read or written, so its units re-run; it records the error once per pass and changes no garden output.
recordOnly.config.randomised_finding: An operator-facing finding naming the routing setting that can carry a randomised winner the mounts table cannot express; the config gardener re-reads it only to write each finding once per evidence day.
recordOnly.config.randomised_recommendations_unread: A diagnostic for a failed read of the randomised evidence; it records the error and changes no candidate.
recordOnly.coverage_nightly.impact_map: Observability for W1-T14530: one row per impact-map refresh; the map file and its run record carry the state lint-plan reads, and no decision reads the row.
recordOnly.dispatch.ops_catalog_hold_cleared: W1-T14532: a diagnostic naming the ops dispatch hold a cycle cleared; nothing reads it, and it changes no dispatch or move decision.
recordOnly.dispatch.ops_selection_changed: An audit row for the operator (W1-T13462): it names the previous and the new ops dispatch selection when the flag changes between cycles, never the repository; nothing decides on it.
recordOnly.dispatch.refill_read: Observability for W1-T14893: whether each lane refill reused the published tick read or read afresh, and why; no decision reads it.
recordOnly.dispatch.selection_timing: Observability for W1-T13286: per-probe selection timing that an operator reads to pick the next speed fix; no decision reads it (invariant measuring-changes-no-decision).
recordOnly.github_app.token_refresh_late: W1-T14537: a diagnostic that a scheduled App token refresh ran after the token it replaced had expired, with how late; it changes no refresh or credential decision.
recordOnly.object_reaper.gc_log_cleared: An operator-facing record that the reaper removed a stale gc.log after a clean full pass, with its age and first line; the following repository_maintenance.complete row carries the gc.log verdict every reader uses, so nothing re-reads it.
recordOnly.reviewer.health_save_superseded: A diagnostic that an evaluation skipped its save because a newer health file was already on disk; the newer file is the state every reader uses, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.reviewer.model_divergence: An operator-facing record of each evaluation's per-model judgement; the incident state in reviewer-health.json carries the decision, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.reviewer.model_divergence_closed: An operator-facing record that a model-divergence incident closed and its issue was closed; the incident state carries the decision, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.reviewer.model_divergence_evidence_added: An operator-facing record that new FAIL evidence was commented on an open model-divergence issue; the incident state records what was published, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.reviewer.model_divergence_evidence_comme: A diagnostic for a failed evidence comment on a model-divergence issue; the evidence stays unpublished in the incident state and the next evaluation retries it.
recordOnly.reviewer.model_divergence_evidence_unava: A diagnostic for a FAIL verdict whose evidence could not be read; it records the error and changes no count.
recordOnly.reviewer.model_divergence_failed: A diagnostic for a per-model health evaluation that threw; it records the error, and the sha-level reviewer health is unaffected.
recordOnly.reviewer.model_divergence_issue_close_fa: A diagnostic for a failed close of a model-divergence issue; it records the error and the issue URL for the operator.
recordOnly.reviewer.model_divergence_opened: An operator-facing record that a model-divergence incident opened with its issue; the incident state carries the decision, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.reviewer.regression_blame_cleared: An operator-facing record of why a reviewer-regression incident closed (the healed and regressed k/n and the offending sha); the closed incident in reviewer-health.json carries the decision, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.reviewer_tree.reaped: An operator record of one reviewer-tree reaper pass: the trees it removed with their bytes, and the trees it kept for a reason an operator may need to act on. The reaper decides each pass from the disk and the tree leases, never from this row.
recordOnly.sweep.fix.admission_release_failed: A diagnostic for a failed release of a fix round's admission lock; the lock is left to the stale-holder check, and the row makes the leak visible.
recordOnly.sweep.fix.deferred_to_live_round: An operator-facing record that a new failure was handed to the live fix round instead of a second round; the hand-off file carries the decision, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.sweep.fix.handoff_cleanup_failed: A diagnostic for a hand-off file that could not be removed after its round ended; it records the error, and the stale file is ignored because its claim and round ids no longer match.
recordOnly.sweep.fix.handoff_unreadable: A diagnostic for a hand-off file that could not be parsed; the round treats it as no hand-off and records the error.
recordOnly.plan.reconcile.reverted_requeue: An audit row for each shard the plan reconcile re-queues after a revert or a remove-credit override; the landing PR and the projection carry the state, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.read_model.now_view_recovered: Observability for W1-T14586: closes a read_model.now_view_failed episode with its failure count and duration; the now view's own map holds the back-off and no decision reads the row.
recordOnly.queue_judge.noop_skipped: A receipt that the queue judge dropped an action whose base shard already carries its priority and exact marker; nothing decides from it, and the next pass judges the task afresh.
recordOnly.task_files_landing.refusal_remembered: A receipt that the task-files landing wrote a record-intrinsic refusal of a blob to its state-dir memory; the landing answers later offers of those bytes from that memory, never from this row.
recordOnly.task_files_landing.gate_findings_unread: A receipt that the landing held on an unread destination-gate log and escalated once for that head; the once-per-head record is the landing's state file, never this row.
recordOnly.sre_lane.unresolved_escalated: W1-T14611: the marker of the page for a primary daemon whose SRE lane could not find its instance; only its own escalation pair in escalation-catalogue.ts reads it, to page once and to find the issue to close.
recordOnly.sre_lane.unresolved_cleared: W1-T14611: the marker that the SRE lane started again and closed that page; only its own escalation pair in escalation-catalogue.ts reads it, so a closed page is not closed twice.
recordOnly.selector-shadow.edge_unreplayable: W1-T13526: the diagnostic row for a miss whose changed paths stayed unread (no base, an unreadable compare or the per-pass read bound spent); it files nothing and stores no edge, and an operator reads it to see why a miss was not filed.
recordOnly.product_plan.checkout_left: W1-T14723: an audit row naming why a product re-plan's checkout was left behind the live head; the refusal body carries the same reason to the Console
recordOnly.plan.reservations_unreadable: W1-T14642: a diagnostic that the reservation ref read failed; the gardener treats the reservations as unknown and the next pass reads again, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.plan.ops_checkout_unreadable: W1-T14642: a diagnostic that the ops catalog checkout could not be read; the pass leaves the ops catalog alone and the next pass reads again, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.plan.ops_landing: W1-T14642: an audit row for the operator naming the ops landing PR and how many records landed, waited or were refused; the PR carries the state, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.plan.ops_landing_skipped: W1-T14642: an audit row naming why an ops landing was not attempted (no named plan destination); nothing decides on it.
recordOnly.plan.ops_landing_failed: W1-T14642: a diagnostic for a failed ops landing with its error; the next pass retries the landing, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.github.delivery: W1-T14881: GitHub's own record of each webhook delivery's status and duration; it is the evidence for webhook timeouts, and only its own pass reads it back (W1-T14979, to redeliver failed ones).
recordOnly.github.delivery.read_failed: W1-T14881: a diagnostic that a delivery-log pass could not read a page; the next pass rereads from the same cursor, so nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.github.delivery.redelivered: W1-T14979: the record that a failed delivery was redelivered once; only its own pass reads it back, to never redeliver twice.
recordOnly.host_memory.shared: W1-T14903: an audit row of the one host memory snapshot both lanes cut from; the widths act on the snapshot itself, and nothing decides on the row.
recordOnly.ci_judge.skipped: PR-unfiled ci-judge reuse: an audit row that a full floor was posted without a model call; the posted status carries the verdict, and nothing decides on the row.
recordOnly.ci_judge.reused: PR-unfiled ci-judge reuse: an audit row that a prior verdict was reposted for an unchanged patch id; the verdicts file carries the state, and nothing decides on the row.
recordOnly.ci_judge.verdicts_unreadable: PR-unfiled ci-judge reuse: a diagnostic that the verdicts file could not be read, so the pass judged afresh; it is rewritten on the same pass, and nothing re-reads the row.
recordOnly.typecheck.waited_for_worktree: W1-T15169: a stderr line that one npm run typecheck waited for another of the same worktree, naming the holder pid and the wait; the lock itself decides, and nothing reads the line.
recordOnly.typecheck.worktree_beat_failed: W1-T15169: a stderr diagnostic that a worktree typecheck lock could not be beaten because it was already released or taken over; the holder runs on, and nothing reads the line.
